purpose: Compare archived joint with R84 R80 hierarchy and paired variants only if exact input and physical-accounting prerequisites pass.
required_before_comparison: All 72 final2.1 eval and 12 dyna1.0 input SHA and actual penalty match exactly.
R84 Van source equals original paired100, not joint; R84 method identities and compilation context checked.
Official physical accounting and request/callback semantics unchanged; inspect engine provenance and relevant code, not just report title.
Original paired and Naive IO/Hit/Miss agree across all matched records (rounded output precision explicitly accounted for).
Historical joint repetitions agree in physical fields; no selection of favorable repeat.
metrics: Per dataset mean of per-case physical ratios, ratio of summed costs, better/equal/worse, worst cases.
Physical cost = recorded IO + actual input penalty * Miss.
Optional physical-only normalized score using matched Naive physical cost; dyna12/final72 each equal-case mean then 50/50 datasets.
exclusions: No joining archived decision times with new timing into a same-window result.
No claim that joint was included in R84 or independently rerun.
No final3.0 input or result, no AI evaluation, no parameter choice from this post hoc analysis.
failure_policy: If prerequisites fail, preserve discrepancy and report non-comparability; do not silently relax tolerances or rerun.
